description:
Only `crate-jmap-mime/Cargo.toml` uses `.workspace = true` field inheritance (for edition/rust-version/license). The other 24 crates duplicate `authors`, `repository`, `edition`, `rust-version`, `license` literally.

This made the recent 'bump all crate versions' commit harder than it had to be: every crate's Cargo.toml had to be edited. The same will happen for the next coordinated change (e.g. updating MSRV, switching repository URL, updating authors).

Recommended: extend root `[workspace.package]` to include:
```toml
[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.75"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["Mark Atwood <mark@reviewcommit.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/MarkAtwood/crate-jmap"
# version = "0.1.1"   # only if all crates are version-locked together
```

Then in each crate's Cargo.toml:
```toml
[package]
name = "jmap-X"
authors.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
```

Keep `version` per-crate if you want independent version cadences (jmap-server is 0.1.2, others 0.1.1).
title: P2: workspace.package inheritance only used by 1 of 25 crates
